info.name: FlutCloud
info.summary: Non-standard server features used by the FlutLink client
info.description:
FlutCloud is the companion Nextcloud app of the FlutLink desktop client. It provides the non-standard features the FlutLink client builds on and identifies the server as a FlutCloud instance via the OCS capabilities.
Features: - FlutCloud capability advertised over the OCS capabilities endpoint - Ping endpoint (verified by the FlutLink client before connecting) - Virtual links (read-only `resources` folders) and writable `parts` - Shared project folder `/FlutLink/FlutCloud` for the OperationFlut team - Complete public shares: anonymous, strictly read-only guest access to folders shared publicly as a whole, bundled at one place with categories (/public/, prefixless per admin config) and recursive subfolder locks - iOS AltStore sources: /apps/flutcloud/ios/pal and /ios/classic always redirect to the source JSON of the latest FlutLink GitHub release
FlutLink connects exclusively to servers that run this app.
FlutCloud and the whole FlutCloud server are managed and all software is developed by @marcante_musik (https://instagram.com/marcante_musik).
